correctness.rationale: Horwitz contact coordinate center was independently recovered from the exact ellipse covariance side-tangency equations; positivity follows from the open medial triangle. Heron gives the exact area map, beta-series expansion by monotone convergence proves all s>=0 moments, uniqueness of the maximum follows from AM–GM, and an explicit negative Hessian with determinant 64 pi^2 /81 gives coefficient 9/4. Independent Python tests of 20000 parameter points, three 680x680 quadratures and local Hessian passed. Finite tests are supplementary, not infinite proof.

value.rationale: Independent uniform side-contact choice is a natural, geometrically operational way to sample all inellipses; unlike center-uniform sampling it yields a nontrivial non-Dirichlet pushforward law. The result gives all moments in a universal closed special-function form, a precise mean, and a sharp probability coefficient for near-Steiner-maximum events. This is a coherent geometric-probability classification rather than a restatement of the deterministic Steiner maximum.
